verdict.rationale: A payments and agentic-commerce platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on merchant data, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers agent checkout protocols, tokenization, product feeds and an MCP server that lets an external LLM client query Adyen in natural language. That MCP server is a developer building block used outside the product, not insights generated inside it, and nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
